top_signals.title: Why Vanguard Is Buying Wealth Platform Altruist
top_signals.summary: Vanguard CEO Salim Ramji and Altruist CEO Jason Wenk explain why they decided to combine assets. Speaking with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest," Ramji and Wenk say they're focused on making financial advisors more accessible. (Source: Bloomberg)
